description:
Whole-market advance/decline/unchanged breadth: how many NSE-listed securities moved
    up/down/flat on a trading day.

    `from_date`/`to_date` are optional ISO dates (default: trailing ~30 days; window capped at
    366 days). Each row is `{trade_date, advances, declines, unchanged, total}`, sourced from
    NSE's own live market-data feed. NSE publishes no bulk historical archive for this figure,
    so history only extends as far back as this server has been capturing it — an empty result
    for a genuinely old date is expected, not a bug. Raw counts only — no "risk-on/risk-off" or
    breadth-based market-direction commentary (SEBI-RA line).
name: get_market_breadth
